Best pre-foundation toner ever! I have oily skin in my T-zone and no matter how many primers or foundations I’ve tried, I looked like a glazed donut in 4 hours. This stuff is amazing. I run around for 12 hours a day and this makes my foundation last ALL day it leaves you’re skin feeling “tight” prior to foundation but it’s seriously the best. Using this and their setting spray I could wear the same make up for 3 days if I wanted to but I’m not a monster so I wash my face daily.

reviews.t: Works! There will be no oil whatsoever on your skin for hours
reviews.x: Wow!! I have super oily skin and I saw that this product might help with keeping my makeup on, it definitely does! But beware that this product will completely take the oil off of your skin. It does make your skin feel very dry. This is not an issue for me since I have very oily skin. Without this product I will be oily within an hour and with this product I will not start to get oily for about 5 hours.

reviews.x: I have Oily skin and cannot EVER find a primer that actually works to combat that alone, much less sweat and humidity, TOO.  This one DOES!!!  🤯 when you first put it on, it almost feels like you put your face in a food dehydrator, but it goes away after a few mins, and then it feels normal.  Actually, it doesn’t feel normal.  It feels BETTER than normal.  It feels MATTIFIED.  Even when I’m visiting my mother in the MOST humid holy Southern corner of HELL that is Georgia🍑🥵…. I love this product. I have idiopathic crainiofacial sweating. I also have rosacea, and broken capillaries. So I wear airbrushed makeup. This product allows me to be exposed to the most sweat producing circumstances, without a single drop rolling down my face. I will never be without it.

reviews.t: It works really well to keep makeup on throughout the ...
reviews.x: It works really well to keep makeup on throughout the day but my skin is prone to break-outs and this definitely irritated my skin. I got several large pimples while wearing this and as soon as I stopped and just used sunscreen and my makeup it went away.

reviews.t: I hated this at first because it goes on and dries ...
reviews.x: I hated this at first because it goes on and dries like you are putting on a mask.  But once it is fully dry it is fine.  You can feel your skin getting tight.  After I saw how great my makeup stayed on, I will be using this on a regular basis.  I have super oily skin and this is as great prep product.  I have also been using a little dab on my eyelids as a primer and this is now my official favorite eye primer. My eye lids stay dry all day. Great product once you get past how it feels going on!

Simply Amazing. I have extremely oily acne-prone skin and this is by far one of the best makeup toner/primers I have used. It does make the skin feel slightly tight once it dried, which to some may be slightly uncomfortable. Doesn't really have much of a smell and keeps my makeup looking fresh all day long. Nothing helped until this product!  It’s now been a week of using this and Mehron’s setting spray.  My face stays matte ALL D

This product keeps my makeup flawless all day long. I worked a 13 hour shift yesterday and was amazed when I got home that my makeup hadn't budged. You definitely need to exfoliate really well before using this product as it does tend to dry out your skin to make sure the makeup stays put (as any good setting product or primer does). Also, this is not a spray. I apply this using cotton rounds. Having a misting cap would be helpful.

claims.text: Reviewers widely report that makeup stays put and looks fresh for 12+ hours, even through heat, humidity, and sweat.
Many reviewers with oily or combination skin say it effectively controls oil and shine.
Several reviewers note the product can dry out or tighten the skin, with an alcohol-like scent and texture.
Some reviewers say it works well for special occasions and long days, though one mentions needing to apply a lot.
One reviewer reports skin irritation and breakouts from using the product.

qa.q: Does it really keep oily skin matte all day?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on duration: some say it keeps skin matte all day [1][2], while another says oil returns after about 5 hours [6]. Several note it leaves skin feeling very dry or tight [1][5][6].

claims.text: It kept skin matte all day.
Oil did not return for about 5 hours.
It makes skin feel very dry or tight.

qa.q: Will it make my makeup last longer without patchiness?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: some say it keeps makeup flawless and prevents patchiness [1][4][5], but others report cracked, dry, textured skin [3].

claims.text: It did not create visible marks or rough spots when makeup was applied [1].
Makeup stays put and looks fresh for 12+ hours without touch up [4].
It keeps makeup flawless all day long [5].
It made skin look cracked and dry and pronounced texture [3].

qa.q: Is it safe for sensitive or acne-prone skin?
qa.answer: One reviewer with extremely oily acne-prone skin called it one of the best primers they've used [5], but others warn it can make skin feel tight and look cracked and dry [2][3], so reviews disagree on comfort for sensitive skin.

claims.text: A reviewer with extremely oily acne-prone skin said it is one of the best makeup toner/primers they have used.
Other reviewers report the product makes skin feel tight and can look cracked and dry.

qa.q: Does it have a strong smell or fragrance?
qa.answer: One review says it doesn't really have much of a smell [2], while another describes it tasting like a deodorant stick when it hit their lip and tongue [5].

claims.text: It doesn't really have much of a smell.
It tasted like a deodorant stick when it hit the lip and tongue.

qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.
